title: Version 1.7.0: Zero-Friction License Transfer, Modernized Feedback UI, CDC Cloud Sync & Admin Console Security
releaseNotes: Hardened Self-Service License Transfer: Instant multi-terminal migration with 6-digit OTP verification and Google OAuth.
Multi-Terminal Seat Pool Synchronization: Dynamic boundHardwareIds allocation preserving remaining counter seats on multi-lane licenses.
Split-Brain Hardware Overwrite Protection: Prohibits retired background terminals from overwriting transferred licenses in Cloud Firestore.
Tenant Snapshot Local Restore Fallback: Offline-first tenant database restoration when transferring via OTP without cloud credentials.
Modernized Floating Feedback System: Premium animated status toasts with tactful dismiss animations across all application views.
Incremental Outbox CDC Queue Optimization: Local transaction batching reducing Firebase document writes by over 90%.
Enterprise Admin Console Security: Real-time physical terminal ping telemetry, remote emergency lockdown, and phone rate-limiting protection.
Dual Signature Verification: Authenticode-signed Windows binaries and installer, and Android APK.
